shared_elements: stone surface carved in low/shallow relief
circle or disc motif (chariot wheel in A; incised disc on B)
weathered grey-brown stone in a museum display setting
justification: Both are weathered stone carved in shallow relief and each contains a prominent incised circle and an anthropomorphic figure, which is the most specific overlap. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a flat horizontal narrative panel with a crowded, detailed multi-figure action scene, while B is a monolithic three-dimensional standing figure whose surface bears only a few sparse, schematic motifs.
